req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint, ensuring it behaves correctly under various conditions. The tests include a positive case to confirm successful deletion, a negative case to handle non-existent task IDs, and a boundary case to test the behavior with the smallest valid task ID.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to ensure it exists
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task_id = create_response.json()["id"]

# Action: Delete the task
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")

# Expected: The response status code is 204
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_task
preconditions: No task with ID 9999 exists in the database.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a non-existent task
response = client.delete("/tasks/9999")

# Expected: The response status code is 404
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 9999 not found"

tests.name: test_delete_task_with_invalid_id
preconditions: The task ID is invalid (e.g., a string instead of an integer).
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task ID is invalid.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a task with an invalid ID
response = client.delete("/tasks/invalid")

# Expected: The response status code is 400
assert response.status_code == 400
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Invalid task ID"
